name: Heavy Hitters
bio: The Heavy Hitters are a Ventura County reggae band formed in 2022 who blend traditional reggae with soul, R&B and neo-soul. Their album The Heavy Hitters came out in 2024.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from heavyhitters.band and @theheavyhittersmusic.
